title: The AI stack in UK trade in volume terms: imports and exports, 2025
source: HMRC Overseas Trade Statistics; ONS UK trade in goods by CPA (MQ10); ONS trade in services (QNA); ukmacro calculations
note: Upper bound: whole product groups, which contain AI and non-AI products (ONS has not yet published AI shares). Layers as in the AI stack charts: the IMF hardware basket and other AI products (HMRC) are inside the ONS extended goods tier (CPA 26-28), and AI services are the ONS core services tier. Volumes at 2019 prices; approximate, as chained volumes aren't strictly additive.
